mapper.select: SELECT account_name,run_mode FROM quant_credential WHERE id=#{credentialId}

SELECT * FROM quant_execution_record WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND operation_type IN ('OPEN','CLOSE') AND (exchange_order_id=#{orderId} OR client_order_id=#{clientOrderId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT strategy_id,strategy_instance_id,reduce_only,position_side,status FROM quant_order WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND exchange_order_id=#{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.protection_type,p.position_side,p.stop_price,p.quantity,p.step_index, s.instance_id,s.direction position_direction,s.entry_price,s.frozen_leverage, s.highest_price_since_entry,s.lowest_price_since_entry,s.strategy_params_snapshot, s.frozen_stop_loss_ratio,s.frozen_symbol_stop_loss_ratio,i.strategy_id FROM quant_protection_order p LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_position_state s ON s.position_id=p.position_id LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_instance i ON i.id=s.instance_id WHERE p.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND p.symbol=#{symbol} AND (p.exchange_order_id=#{orderId} OR p.client_order_id=#{clientOrderId}) LIMIT 1

SELECT p.protection_type,p.position_side,p.stop_price,p.quantity,p.step_index, s.direction position_direction,s.entry_price,s.frozen_leverage,s.highest_price_since_entry, s.lowest_price_since_entry,s.strategy_params_snapshot,s.frozen_stop_loss_ratio, s.frozen_symbol_stop_loss_ratio,i.strategy_id,i.id instance_id FROM quant_protection_order p JOIN quant_strategy_position_state s ON s.position_id=p.position_id JOIN quant_strategy_instance i ON i.id=s.instance_id WHERE p.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND p.symbol=#{symbol} AND p.client_order_id=#{clientOrderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT strategy_name FROM quant_strategy WHERE id=#{strategyId}
SELECT SUM(quantity) qty,SUM(quantity*price) amount,MAX(trade_time) last_fill FROM quant_trade_decision_log WHERE parent_key=#{parentKey} AND record_type='FILL'
SELECT quantity,price,trade_time FROM quant_trade_decision_log WHERE parent_key=#{parentKey} AND record_type='FILL' ORDER BY trade_time,id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO quant_trade_decision_log (event_key,record_type,credential_id,account_name,run_mode,strategy_id,strategy_instance_id,strategy_name, symbol,operation,direction,status,reason_code,reason,angle,threshold,kline_time,quantity,price,margin, idempotency_key,order_id,client_order_id,event_time,trade_time,repeat_count,last_time) VALUES
(#{row.eventKey},#{row.recordType},#{row.credentialId},#{row.accountName},#{row.runMode}, #{row.strategyId},#{row.strategyInstanceId},#{row.strategyName},#{row.symbol},#{row.operation}, #{row.direction},#{row.status},#{row.reasonCode},#{row.reason},#{row.angle},#{row.threshold}, #{row.klineTime},#{row.quantity},#{row.price},#{row.margin},#{row.idempotencyKey},#{row.orderId}, #{row.clientOrderId},#{row.firstTime},#{row.tradeTime},#{row.count},#{row.eventTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE repeat_count=repeat_count+VALUES(repeat_count), last_time=GREATEST(last_time,VALUES(last_time)),price=VALUES(price), angle=VALUES(angle),reason=VALUES(reason)

INSERT INTO quant_trade_decision_log (event_key,record_type,credential_id,account_name,run_mode,strategy_id,strategy_instance_id,strategy_name, symbol,operation,direction,status,reason_code,reason,angle,threshold,kline_time,quantity,price,margin, idempotency_key,order_id,client_order_id,event_time,trade_time,repeat_count,last_time,parent_key) VALUES (#{row.eventKey},#{row.recordType},#{row.credentialId},#{row.accountName},#{row.runMode}, #{row.strategyId},#{row.strategyInstanceId},#{row.strategyName},#{row.symbol},#{row.operation}, #{row.direction},#{row.status},#{row.reasonCode},#{row.reason},#{row.angle},#{row.threshold}, #{row.klineTime},#{row.quantity},#{row.price},#{row.margin},#{row.idempotencyKey},#{row.orderId}, #{row.clientOrderId},#{row.eventTime},#{row.tradeTime},1,#{row.eventTime},#{row.parentKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_key=VALUES(parent_key)
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_trade_decision_log SET parent_key=#{target} WHERE parent_key=#{source} AND record_type='FILL'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM quant_trade_decision_log WHERE event_key=#{source} AND record_type<>'FILL'
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_trade_decision_log SET quantity=#{quantity},price=#{price},trade_time=#{tradeTime}, status=CASE WHEN status IN ('FILLED','CANCELED','EXPIRED','REJECTED','EXPIRED_IN_MATCH') THEN status ELSE #{status} END, last_time=GREATEST(last_time,#{eventTime}) WHERE event_key=#{parentKey} AND (trade_time IS NULL OR quantity IS NULL OR quantity<=#{quantityLimit})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quant_trade_decision_log WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type<>'FILL'
